advanced-filter-description: Saringan lanjot jeuet geutuleh seubagoe teks ngon operator nyoe: == != <= >= && || ( ) Spasi geungui keu peupisah antara operator. Droeneueh jeuet saring mandum ruang khusus ngon tuleh nan ngon nilai jih. Contoh: Field1 == Value1. Catatan: Meunyoe ruang atawa nilai na spasi, droeneueh haroh boh tanda petik tunggai di keue ngon di likot jih. Contoh: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Keu escape karakter kontrol tunggai (' \/) nyan, droeneueh jeuet ngui \. Contoh: Field1 == I\'m. Droeneueh jeuet gabong le kondisi. Contoh: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Ngon setelan awai, mandum operator geupeubuet nibak wie u uneuen. Droeneueh jeuet ubah urutan ngon boh tanda kurong. Contoh: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Droeneueh jeuet mita ruang teks ngon regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

email-recovery-busy: Teungoh geukirem atawa geupeubuet buet laén bak daftar. Peubarô ngon cuba lom lheueh siat.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Batal mandum peusan nyang jinoe lam daftar keu ureueng nyang teurimong nyoe? Aso jih geuboih ngon hana jeuet geupeuwoe lom. Peusan barô nyang geupeugöt lheueh peumintaan nyoe geukeubah.
email-recovery-description: Saboh bareh keu ureueng nyang teurimong maséng-maséng. Mita ngon ID ureueng ngui. Aso peusan ngon kolom emel ureueng nyang teurimong hana geupeuleumah. Peupioh siat geutahan peusan nyang ka na ngon nyang teuma teuka; peulanjut geucuba kirem lom peusan lam daftar jinoe. Batal geuboih peusan nyang ka tamong daftar trok bak watee peumintaan. Meunyo mantong geukirem, cuba lom lheueh siat. Peusan nyang ka geupeuphon kirem hana jeuet tacok woe, ngon peungiriman nyang hana pasti hasé jih jeuet teukirem dua go. Peungiriman nyang gagal sabe ngon peusan nyang ka trok bateueh cuba geukeubah keu geupeurèksa. Cuba lom peusan nyang gagal geupeuphon putaran cuba barô ngon geujaga peupioh siat nyang ka na.
email-recovery-empty: Hana peusan lam daftar atawa ureueng nyang peungiriman keu jih ka geupeupioh siat.
email-recovery-failed: Buet nyoe hana jeuet geupasti. Peubarô daftar ngon cuba lom buet nyang saban meunyo peureulèe.
email-recovery-superseded: Buet nyang leubèh barô nibak ureueng peujak sistem ka geuganto peumintaan nyoe. Keuadaan daftar jinoe geupeuleumah.
email-recovery-unavailable: Hana jeuet geubeuet daftar emel. Peurèksa hak ureueng atô ngon meunyo server jeuet geungui.

error-json-malformed: Teks droeneueh kon JSON nyang sah
error-json-schema: Data JSON droeneueh hana na informasi nyang teupat lam format nyang beutoi
error-notAuthorized: Droeneueh hana izin keu ngieng laman nyoe.
error-user-notSameOrgOrTeam: Droeneueh jeuet tamah ureueng ngui nibak Organisasi atawa Tim nyang saban mantong
error-username-taken: Nan ureueng ngui nyoe ka geungui
export-card-details: Rincian kad (tiep kad lagee lam ekspor kad)
export-card-field-people: Ureueng (Peugöt, Ureueng po, Anggota, Ureueng nyang geubri buet)
filter-on-desc: Droeneueh teungoh saring kad bak papan nyoe. Klik keunoe keu sunting saringan.
import-attachment-auth-hint: Ekspor nyan geuseubut nan lampiran, tapi hana geuba beureukah jih. Mangat jeut geuba, peutamong alamat layanan ngon tanda tamong: nyan geunguy keu impor nyoe mantong, geukirém keu alamat nyan mantong, ngon hana geukeubah. Peuthon kosong keu impor tanpa beureukah.
import-attachment-auth-token: Token API, kunci API atawa kata sandi aplikasi
import-board-instruction-asana: Tempel JSON ekspor tasks Asana ({ "data": [...] } nibak ekspor Asana atawa GET /tasks). Task geukumpoi lam bagian (memberships); task nyang ka seuleusoe jak u Done.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Bak Businessmap (dilee Kanbanize), buka Advanced Search, pileh Configure results keu pileh kolom, unduh file Excel, lheuh nyan pileh file .xlsx nyan. Kolom geubaca ngon nan Inggreh jih (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): meunyoe akun droeneueh jingui bahsa laen, ganto phon nan baréh kepala u bahsa Inggreh. Column jeuet keu dapeuta ngon Lane jeuet keu jalur; ureueng po, tag, warna, tanggal, komen ngon link induk tetap bak teumpat jih, ngon Priority, Size, Type ngon kolom laen jeuet keu ruang khusus.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Bak ClickUp, ekspor tugaih sibagoe CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, atawa ekspor view List atawa Table ngon bandum kolom), lheuh nyan tempel CSV. Status jeuet keu dapeuta, dapeuta ClickUp jeuet keu jalur, ngon tugaih jeuet keu kad ngon subtugas, ureueng geutugaih, tag, tanggal, prioritas ngon watèe jih.
import-board-instruction-csv: Tempel Comma Separated Values(CSV)/ Tab Separated Values (TSV) droeneueh.
import-board-instruction-deck: Tempel JSON papan NextCloud Deck (saboh papan ngon "stacks", tiep stack ba "cards" jih). Stack jadi dapeuta ngön cards jadi kad.
import-board-instruction-excel: Pileh saboh workbook .xlsx: tabel ngön saboh kad bak tiep baréh (kolom lagèe Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, tanggai ngön ruang khusuih), atawa workbook nyang geuekspor lé WeKan, cit nyang ngön tiep papan bak sheet droe jih. Langkah lheueh nyoe geupeuleumah kolom pat keu ruang pat. Tiep sheet nyang na baréh kepala jeuet keu saboh papan.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Peuhah fail .boardarchive nibak zip dan tampèe asoe board.jsonl nibak papan, ngön baréh versi atawa hana. Sifeut peusapat lam tampilan papan jeuet keu dapeuta, sifeut pilihan laén jeuet keu label, blok teks ngon kotak tanda jeuet keu peunerangan ngon dapeuta peumeriksa, dan komentar geukeubah. Gamba ngon fail lampiran hana geupeutamong.
import-board-instruction-issues: Tempel array JSON issues __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Issue jadi kad nyang geukumpoi lam dapeuta Open / Closed.
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Tempel JSON ekspor Kanboard: saboh objek ngon "columns" (atawa tasks nyang ba column_name) ngön array "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Kolom jadi dapeuta ngön task jadi kad.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Bak Kanri, buka Import & Export ngon pileh Export individual board (atawa Export all data), lheuh nyan tempel file .json. Kolom jeuet keu dapeuta ngon kad jeuet keu kad, ngon deskripsi, uroe bataih, tag ngon warna jih; tugaih bak kad jeuet keu checklist. Nibak ekspor bandum data, papan phon nyang geuimpor.
import-board-instruction-leo: Tempel susônan Leo (fail .leo). Bagian bak tingkat paléng ateuh jeuet keu dapeuta, aneuk jih jeuet keu kad ngön isi bagian sibagoe deskripsi, ngön bagian nyang leubèh dalam jeuet keu checklist. Bagian nyang ka geuboh tanda geuimpor sibagoe nyang ka seuleusoe.
import-board-instruction-linear: Bak Linear, ekspor isu sibagoe CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, atawa ekspor saboh view), lheuh nyan tempel CSV. Status jeuet keu dapeuta, tim jeuet keu jalur, ngon isu jeuet keu kad ngon ureueng geutugaih, label, tanggal, isu induk, prioritas, peukira, proyek ngon siklus jih.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Tempel saboh dapeuta tugaih markdown (aturan nyang geungui lé alat markdown-kanban lagèe Obsidian Kanban): kepala "## Nan dapeuta", ngön item "- [ ]"/"- [x]" di yup jih. Kepala jeuet keu dapeuta ngön item jeuet keu kad; dapeuta biasa nyang hana kutak tanda cit jeuet geuimpor, sibagoe kad nyang goh seuleusoe.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Bak MeisterTask, klik nan proyek, pileh Export project ngon ekspor CSV, lheuh nyan tempel. Bagian jeuet keu dapeuta ngon tugaih jeuet keu kad, ngon catatan, uroe bataih, ureueng geutugaih ngon tag jih; tugaih nyang ka leusoe tetap na tanggal leusoe jih. CSV nyang geutuléh keu impor MeisterTask keudroe pih jeuet.
import-board-instruction-monday: Bak monday.com, buka menu papan, pileh More actions ngon Export board to Excel (ngon updates ngon subitems meunyoe neutem), lheuh nyan pileh file .xlsx nyan. Kolom Status jeuet keu dapeuta ngon kelompok jeuet keu jalur; ureueng, tanggal, timeline ngon tag tetap bak teumpat jih, kolom laen jeuet keu ruang khusus ngon updates jeuet keu komen.
import-board-instruction-notion: Bak Notion, buka database sibagoe on peunoh, pileh ••• ngon Export, pileh Markdown & CSV, ngon pileh file .zip nyang geuunduh, atawa saboh CSV database nibak nyan, atawa tempel CSV nyan. Kolom ngon nan Status jeuet keu dapeuta (meunyoe hana, kolom phon nyang lagee pileh jeuet keu dapeuta, ngon laporan impor geupeugah kolom pat); baréh jeuet keu kad ngon judul, tag sibagoe label, ureueng sibagoe anggota, tanggal, ngon teks on sibagoe deskripsi; kolom laen jeuet keu ruang khusus. Hubongan, gamba ngon lampiran h'an geuimpor.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Bak Nullboard, buka papan, pileh Export this board... nibak menu, buka file .nbx bak editor teks ngon tempel isi jih. Dapeuta jeuet keu dapeuta ngon catatan jeuet keu kad: baréh phon catatan jeuet keu judul kad ngon sisa jih jeuet keu deskripsi. Catatan mentah meuteumee label raw. File ngon padum boh papan geuimpor papan phon jih.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Bak Obsidian, buka file papan Kanban sibagoe Markdown (atawa buka file .md bak editor teks), lheuh nyan tempel bandum. Lajôr jeuet keu dapeuta ngon bataih kad jih, kad tetap na tag, tanggal, prioritas, ruang ngon checklist jih, ngon Arsip jeuet keu kad nyang ka geuarsip.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Tempel JSON koleksi work-packages OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Status jadi dapeuta ngön work package jadi kad.
import-board-instruction-opml: Tempel garéh beusa OPML, lagee nyang geuekspor le Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq ngon outliner laen. Item tingkat ateuh jeuet keu dapeuta, aneuk jih jeuet keu kad ngon catatan sibagoe deskripsi, ngon item nyang leubeh dalam jeuet keu checklist. Item nyang ka leusoe geuimpor sibagoe ka leusoe.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Tempel file Org mode, lagee nyang geutuléh le Emacs, Orgzly atawa Beorg. Judul tingkat ateuh jeuet keu dapeuta ngon judul tingkat dua jeuet keu kad. TODO ngon DONE, prioritas, tag, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE ngon CLOSED geupeutheun, ngon kotak cek ngon judul nyang leubeh dalam jeuet keu checklist.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Bak Pivotal Tracker, buka tab MORE proyek ngon pileh Export CSV (atawa pileh story ngon pileh Bulk Actions, CSV), lheuh nyan tempel CSV. Tiep keuadaan story jeuet keu dapeuta ngon story jeuet keu kad, ngon jeunèh ngon label, ureueng po, ureueng lakée, tanggal, komen, tugaih ngon peuhambat jih; Estimate jeuet keu Story points ngon iterasi jeuet keu sprint.
import-board-instruction-plane: Bak Plane, buka Workspace Settings, pileh Exports, ekspor proyek sibagoe JSON, CSV atawa Excel ngon unduh file .zip, lheuh nyan pileh file nyan, atawa saboh file nibak dalam jih, atawa tempel JSON atawa CSV. Keuadaan jeuet keu dapeuta, proyek jeuet keu jalur, ngon isu jeuet keu kad ngon tanda, induk, ureueng geutugaih, label, tanggal, link ngon komen jih; prioritas, peukira, siklus ngon modul jeuet keu ruang khusus. Ekspor Plane hana deskripsi atawa lampiran, nyan pasai h'an geuimpor.
import-board-instruction-planner: Bak Microsoft Planner, peuhah rencana, pileh meunu ⋯ bak sisi nan jih, laju Export as Excel (bak Planner klasik: Export plan to Excel), ngön pileh fail .xlsx nyan. Bucket jeuet keu dapeuta ngön tugaih jeuet keu kad, ngön ureueng nyang geubri buet, tanggai, label, checklist ngön deskripsi jih; Progress, Priority ngön Completed By jeuet keu ruang khusuih.
import-board-instruction-quire: Bak Quire, buka menu proyek ngon pileh Export CSV, lheuh nyan tempel CSV. Status jeuet keu dapeuta ngon tugaih jeuet keu kad, ngon subtugas jih sibagoe kad aneuk, ureueng geutugaih, tag sibagoe label, tanggal phon, bataih ngon leusoe, deskripsi ngon prioritas sibagoe ruang khusus. Komen ngon lampiran hana lam CSV Quire.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Bak Redmine, buka Issues proyek, pileh Also available in: CSV bak bagian bawah dapeuta, pileh kolom (All columns, ngon Description) ngon ekspor, lheuh nyan tempel CSV. Redmine geubri nan kolom lam bahsa droeneueh, nyan pasai atô bahsa droeneueh u bahsa Inggreh bak My account sigohlom ekspor. Tiep status jeuet keu dapeuta ngon isu jeuet keu kad, ngon tracker sibagoe label, ureueng geutugaih, ureueng tuléh, tanggal, tugaih induk ngon isu meuhubong; prioritas, kategori, versi tujuan, watèe peukira, % Done ngon ruang khusus jeuet keu ruang khusus.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Bak Super Productivity, buka Settings, lheuh nyan Sync & Backup, pileh Export Data ngon tempel isi file .json sp-backup. Tiep proyek jeuet keu jalur ngon tugaih jeuet keu kad bak To Do, In Progress, Backlog atawa Done, ngon catatan, tag, uroe bataih, watèe nyang ka geungui ngon subtugas jih; tugaih nyang ka geuarsip jeuet keu kad nyang ka geuarsip.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Bak Taiga, buka Admin > Project > Export ngon unduh dump proyek (buka phon file .json.gz), lheuh nyan tempel JSON jih. Status user story jeuet keu dapeuta, user story jeuet keu kad ngon tugaih jih sibagoe subtugas, epic ngon isu meuteumee jalur keudroe, ngon sprint, tag, komen ngon atribut khusus pih ikot. Lampiran h'an geuimpor.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Bak Tasks.org, buka Settings, Backups ngon pileh Export tasks, lheuh nyan tempel isi file .json nyan. Dapeuta jeuet keu dapeuta ngon tugaih jeuet keu kad, ngon catatan, tag, tanggal, komen ngon subtugas jih; tugaih nyang ka leusoe tetap na tanggal leusoe jih, ngon prioritas jeuet keu ruang khusus.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Tempel hasé task export: saboh array JSON, atawa saboh tugaih bak tiep baréh. Tugaih nyang ka seuleusoe jak u Done, project ngön priority jeuet keu label, annotations jeuet keu komen, ngön depends jeuet keu meugantông bak tugaih nyang hambat.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Bak Teamwork.com, peupeunoh templat impor tugaih Excel (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) ngon keubah sibagoe .xlsx, lheuh nyan pileh file nyan. Dapeuta tugaih jeuet keu dapeuta ngon tugaih jeuet keu kad; tugaih nyang geupeuphon ngon -, # atawa > jeuet keu subtugas nibak tugaih di ateuh jih (--, ## atawa >> saboh tingkat leubeh dalam). Ureueng geutugaih, tanggal ngon tag tetap bak teumpat jih; Priority, Estimated time ngon Complete jeuet keu ruang khusus.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Bak TickTick, buka Settings, Account, Backup & Import ngon peugöt cadangan, lheuh nyan tempel file CSV. Tiep dapeuta TickTick jeuet keu jalur ngon kolom jih jeuet keu dapeuta; tugaih tetap na tag, tanggal, checklist, prioritas ngon subtugas jih.
import-board-instruction-todoist: Bak Todoist, peuhah proyek, pileh meunu ⋯ bak ateuh uneun jih, laju Manage data > Export as CSV, ngön tempel fail CSV nyan. Bagian jeuet keu dapeuta, tugaih jeuet keu kad, subtugaih jeuet keu checklist, catatan jeuet keu komen, ngön @label ngön prioritas p1 sampoe p3 jeuet keu label.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Tempel fail todo.txt: saboh tugaih bak saboh baréh, lagèe nyang geutuléh lé aplikasi todo.txt ngön aplikasi nyang sisuai. Tugaih nyang ka seuleusoe ("x") jak u Seuleusoe, +project ngön @context jeuet keu label, (A) jeuet keu label prioritas, due: ngön t: jeuet keu tanggai tempo ngön tanggai phôn.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Bak Vikunja, buka Settings, pileh Data Export ngon unduh file .zip nyang geukirém u droeneueh, lheuh nyan pileh file nyan, atawa tempel data.json nyang na lam jih. Ember Kanban jeuet keu dapeuta ngon tugaih jeuet keu kad, ngon label, ureueng geutugaih, tanggal, deskripsi, dapeuta tugaih sibagoe checklist ngon komen jih; prioritas, persen leusoe ngon leusoe jeuet keu ruang khusus. Lampiran h'an geuimpor.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Bak Wrike, ekspor proyek atawa map u Excel, atawa peupeunoh templat impor Excel Wrike, lheuh nyan pileh file .xlsx nyan. Baréh map ngon proyek jeuet keu jalur, Status jeuet keu dapeuta ngon tugaih jeuet keu kad, ngon Key, tugaih induk, ureueng geutugaih, tanggal phon ngon akhé, ketergantungan ngon deskripsi jih; Priority, Duration ngon kolom laen jeuet keu ruang khusus.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Tempel JSON ekspor list ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stage jadi dapeuta ngön item jadi kad.
import-file-label: Pileh file ekspor, atawa tempel teks jih di bawah:
import-members-map: Papan nyang geupeutamong na anggota. Peupadan anggota nyang keuneuk geupeutamong ngon ureueng ngui droeneueh
import-members-map-note: Catatan: Anggota nyang hana geupeupadan akan geubri u ureueng ngui jinoe.
import-members-mode-map: Pileh ureueng ngui nyang ka na keu tiep ureueng
import-members-mode-placeholder: Peutheun sibagoe ureueng ngui peuganto ngon nan keudroe, keu geuhubong u ureueng ngui asli lheuh nyoe
import-one-board-per-project-hint: Tiep jalur nyang geupeugöt le impor (saboh proyek, map atawa dapeuta alat) jeuet keu papan keudroe. Kad induk ngon ketergantungan antara papan nyan geutuléh lam laporan impor.
import-report-description: Papan ka geupeugot, teuma na padum bagi lam fail nyang hana jeut geuba. Laporan nyang sama geukeubah bak Panel Admin → Masalah → Peuulang.
import-too-large: Fail nyan rayeuk that keu geupeutamong sigo. Neubagi jeut keu fail-fail ubit, contoh meunurot proyek atawa meunurot tanggai, laju neupeutamong saboh-saboh.
instance-desc: Mandum ureueng ngui nyang ka tamong u WeKan nyoe jeuet kalön papan nyoe. Papan nyoe hana tom geupeuleumah keu ureueng nyang goh lom tamong. Ureueng nyang ka geutamah u papan mantong nyang jeuet ubah.
invalid-file: Meunyoe nan fail hana sah, unggah atawa ubah nan geubatai.
invalid-year: Thon hana sah. Neutuléh mandum peuet angka, contoh jih 2026.
just-invited: Droeneueh ban geuundang u papan nyoe
list-permissions-desc: Peue nyang jeuet geupeubuet le tiep peran bak dapeuta nyoe, leubeh nibak nyang geuidin le papan. Admin papan sabe jeuet geusunting.
list-select-cards: Pileh mandum kad bak senarai nyoe
muted-info: Droeneueh hana akan geubri notifikasi peue mantong perubahan bak papan nyoe
name: Nan
normal-assigned-only: Biasa keu nyang geubri buet mantong
notification-delivery-layout-clear: Geuatô ngon jeulaih: papan, soe, kad ngon huruf teubay
password-change-required-text: Situs nyoe jinoe jilakee kata sandi paleng kureung __min__ karakter, ngön kata sandi droeneuh leubeh paneuk. Pileh nyang leubeh panyang mangat jeuet lanjut. Mandum sesi akun droeneuh laju geuteubiet, ngön droeneuh tamong lom ngön kata sandi barô.
password-length-filter-fixed: Ka geupeugot keu kata sandi nyang cukôp panyang
password-length-from-environment: Nilai nyang geupasang lam lingkungan server teungöh beurlaku; keubah disinoe jigantoe nyan.
password-length-report-desc: Akun nyang tamong ngön kata sandi nyang leubeh paneuk nibak panyang paleng kureung. Cit browser mantong nyang tuphö padum panyang kata sandi, maka jih jilapor kata sandi nyang paneuk lheuh tamong; kata sandi ngön panyang jih hana tom teubiet nibak browser. Ka geupeugot meunyo kata sandi akun ka geu-ubah - akun nyang tamong lom ngön kata sandi paneuk geupeuleumah lom sibagoe paneuk that.
password-min-length-description: Tamong ngön kata sandi nyang leubeh paneuk geupeuleumah di yup nyoe. Tamong hana tom geutolak keu nyan.
password-min-length-enforce-description: Kata sandi barô nyang leubeh paneuk geutolak, ngön akun nyang tamong ngön kata sandi leubeh paneuk wajeb jiubah dilee sigohlom nyang laen. Meng-ubah jih jiteubiet mandum sesi akun. Kata sandi LDAP, OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, CAS ngön Sandstorm nyan milek penyedia jih, ngön hana geuperiksa.
password-pwned: Kata sandi nyoe ka meutamöng lam bocoran data. Pileh nyang laen.
password-same-as-username: Kata sandi bek sama ngon nan ureueng ngui atawa alamat emel.
password-too-short: Kata sandi beu paleng kureung __min__ karakter.
preview-pdf-not-supported: Perangkat droeneueh hana dukong pratinjau PDF. Neucuba download fail jih.
private-desc: Papan nyoe pribadi. Ureueng nyang geutamah u papan mantong jeuet ngieng ngon sunting jih.
public-desc: Papan nyoe publik. Soe mantong nyang na tautan jeuet ngieng jih, ngon jih akan deuh bak mesin pencarian lagee Google. Ureueng nyang geutamah u papan mantong jeuet sunting.
r-add-actinguser-member: Tamah ureueng nyang peuteubiet aturan nyoe sibagoe anggota
r-blocks-conflict: Aturan nyoe meuubah watèe droeneueh teungoh sunting. Muat ulang aturan nyang ka geukeubah sigohlom keubah.
r-blocks-discard: Boh peuubahan blok nyang goh geukeubah?
r-blocks-help: Hubong saboh pemicu u saboh buet. Seuret blok nibak kotak alat. Ngui editor formulir keu peumileh lanjutan.
r-blocks-invalid: Hubong pah saboh pemicu u saboh buet. Hapus blok nyang h'an meuhubong atawa leubeh sigohlom keubah.
r-blocks-permission: Peureulee izin admin papan keu sunting aturan.
r-blocks-reload: Muat ulang aturan nyang ka geukeubah
r-blocks-unavailable: Data aturan hana. Ngui editor formulir keu kalon aturan nyoe.
r-cron-invalid: Jadwal cron na limong bagian: minèt jeum uroe buleuen uroe-minggu.
r-d-move-to-bottom-gen: Pinah kad u miyup senarai jih
r-d-move-to-top-gen: Pinah kad u ateueh senarai jih
r-email-members-hint: Anggota papan nyang geutamah dari dapeuta jitamong u "kepada" sibagoe @username ngon geukirém u alamat emel droe anggota nyan. Alamat emel laén mantong jeuet geutuléh lam "kepada".
r-import-paste: Tempel aturan nyang geuekspor (JSON atawa CSV) atawa peurintah Trello Butler keunoe
r-import-trello: Impor aturan nibak Trello Butler (useuha nyang paléng got)
r-import-trello-note: Ekspor papan Trello hana na aturan Butler. Tempel teks peurintah Butler keunoe keu peucocok bagian nyang geudukông; baréh nyang hana geucocok geulapor.
r-import-workflow-note: Impor alur kerja visual nyang geuekspor nibak n8n atawa Node-RED. Node pemicu/aksi nyang geuturi geucocok u aturan WeKan; node nyang hana geucocok geulapor.
r-import-wrike-workflow-done: Alur kerja Wrike "__name__": __lists__ dapeuta ngon __rules__ aturan geutamah, __skipped__ bagian h'an geubaca
r-insert-variable: Peutamong variabel bak kotak teks nyang droeneuh pileh paléng akhé:
r-moved-back: geupinah u likôt u dapeuta sigohlom nyoe
r-moved-forward: geupinah u keue u dapeuta lheuh nyoe

r-wrike-workflow-note: Alur kerja Wrike nakeuh dapeuta status, tiep status lam kelompok Active, Completed, Deferred atawa Cancelled. Ekspor geutuléh dapeuta papan nyoe sibagoe saboh alur, ngon nan papan, lam JSON nyang geupeuwoe le API Wrike keu alur kerja: peugöt alur kerja nyan bak Wrike sigohlom impor ekspor Excel Wrike papan nyoe, mangat status jih geungui. Impor geubaca JSON nyang geutempel di ateuh, nibak WeKan atawa nibak GET /workflows Wrike, u papan nyang geupileh: status nyang hana dapeuta jeuet keu dapeuta, ngon saboh aturan geutanda kad leusoe meunyoe geupinah u status Completed atawa Cancelled ngon goh leusoe bak status Active atawa Deferred. Aturan otomatis Wrike keudroe h'an jeuet geuekspor nibak Wrike.

Pengamatan nyoe h'an geucatat bandum peuubahan atawa h'an geupeuleumah jumlah akhé uroe. Peukira nyang h'an geuthee kon sifar. Ngui buet Ekspor bagian nyoe keu pengamatan tiep uroe; buet Ekspor bak baréh alat geuekspor hase sprint.

Peutheun papan lagee jinoe geuhapus operasi nyang meuhenti ngon h'an geuubah catatan pajan pih. Pajan pih, nyoe geucatat lam Panel Admin, Masalah, Pemulihan.
